text_block_list.text:
One day. In preparation for the Kokura Kinen,
I traveled to Kyushu with Nice Nature
to scout the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—That course sure had a lot of quirks.
Pace distribution looks to be the key.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I actually came to see it in person.
I'm glad we actually came to see it in person!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I did wonder,
'A scouting trip all the way to Kyushu?' though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I got to enjoy some racecourse food, I learned a few things,
and it's just been one good thing after another~!
choice_data_list: Is there anywhere else you want to see?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I've pretty much seen everything, so...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look.
You really don't need to walk on eggshells around me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, today certainly serves as a scouting trip,
but there's more to it, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"This is partly to help me clear my head, right?
...Because you saw me feeling down."

"Nice Nature had fiercely contested with Tokai Teio
in the race. Despite achieving a good result, she was
feeling down due to her lack of confidence."

So just as she said, I took her all the way out to Kyushu for a change of pace...
but it seems she saw right through me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You'd best not underestimate the insight
I inherited from my mother~ Just kidding!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I mean, I'm not really
as down in the dumps as you think, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, my opponent was Teio.
There was way too big a gap in sparkle right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"And getting all bummed out over it...?
No way, that's just not gonna fly!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Talk about not knowing your place.
"...Even as she said that, a hint of frustration seemed to seep through."

What can I do to help her gain confidence...?
Is there anything I can do for her?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, Captain! I found a shopping street!
Or rather, their sign really screams for attention.

"'Shopping District'...
Come to think of it—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides... everyone cheers for me
like it's the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"*Me*, of all people, you know?
It's honestly laughable."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "It's almost laughable how much they care about me..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And when people cheer me on,
it kinda makes me think, "Let's do this!"
...This is it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait, Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...You know, shopping districts kinda have the exact same vibe no matter where you go~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In terms of liveliness,
this side is definitely way more hyped up, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer-san. It's not like I'm some shopping street collector, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm always up for a detour, though!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Now, now, I wonder if there's any shop that can satisfy Nature-san's finely honed standards?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that fish is super fresh!
Look, the scales are all shiny!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, not to be underestimated~.
To think you could find fish like this circulating in a normal shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, little miss Umamusume!
You sure got a good eye picking that fish~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?
Back home, I'm known for having a discerning eye~

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Woah, that's amazin'!
In that case, I'll give ya a quiz!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Between the squid on the right and the squid on the left,
which one would you pick, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The left one, obviously!
The sparkle in her eyes is completely on another level!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
I'm beat, I'm beat! Man,
what an insanely awesome girl showed up!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text: "I'll give ya that squid, so go have 'em cook it up at the shop in the back!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious!?
Man, sorry to trouble ya!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, lucky♪
You've gotta take advantage of kindness when it's offered!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go, let's go!

...After that, Nice Nature continued visiting various shops,
enjoying her interactions with the people of the shopping district.

As time passed,
her expression gradually softened, and then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so fun!
As expected of Kyushu, everyone was so energetic~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The way they talk is pretty neat-cha too, ya know?"
Look at me, picking up fake dialects now.
choice_data_list: That really cheered me up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, totally.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Shouting at the top of our lungs, laughing together... It feels like it's been forever since I've cut loose like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I haven't been able to visit Kimie-san
and the others lately, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I don't feel like I can smile properly right now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No matter what results I get, everyone is happy for me.
They smile and tell me I did my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't really tell for myself.
Yeah... I can't bring myself to say I gave it my all, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, first place is pretty straightforward, right?
You get a trophy, or the shield if it's the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that makes me feel like my hard work paid off.
...Though that feeling is a privilege reserved only for 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, while being unconditionally accepted is
something to be grateful for... well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess... to me,
hearing people cheer 'Nei-chan' meant the world.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah, now I'm kinda frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because everything went
exactly as you planned, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I must confess.
...I feel completely and utterly refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I won't even be able to make the excuse of 'I didn't do well because I wasn't feeling great.'
choice_data_list: Then let's go get some results.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aah!
That's power harassment under the guise of pressure!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That might've thrown off my groove just now~
I'm pretty delicate, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, just kidding!
Ehehe...

What truly cheers Nice Nature up
must be the people cheering for her.
It was a great day, one that raises high hopes for a strong showing in the Kokura Kinen...
